mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during episodes where GDPC1 falls by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6.0% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing corporate margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 6.0% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO of more than 0.5% for three consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month and < previous month - 0.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during three-month INDPRO declines exceeding 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS and a fall in UNRATE indicates a situation where employment expands but at a slower pace of labor force growth, signaling moderate wage growth and stable demand, which supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in HOUST above its 12-month moving average by more than 10% signals strengthening housing demand, which boosts construction and related equities, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during months when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average by more than 10%.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated decline in both FEDFUNDS and RSAFS (reserves) below their 6-month averages signals a reduction in monetary and liquidity support, which tightens financial conditions and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and RSAFS both fall below their 6-month averages in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS and RSAFS fall below their 6-month averages in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL above 3% for four consecutive months signals high inflation, which erodes real corporate earnings and increases discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during four consecutive months of CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.
